method: libdxfrw opened each native AutoCAD 2000 DWG independently. Each standalone drawing has a zero insertion base and centered modelspace sign geometry. Importing that geometry into a test host containing an existing red sign definition under its filename simulates external INSERT. An ezdxf color render checks its native appearance on white. Bounding boxes are measured from reopened geometric entities in inches. The visual observations compare the decoded drawing to the indicated source publication or plan crop.

browserReleaseVerification.method: Chrome followed the catalog record to the sign page, clicked the native download, and saved the file. libdxfrw reopened each sampled DWG. All master block inserts and all individual drawings in the ZIP were counted and hash checked.
